name: The Whispering Gears
description: A section of the lower city's ventilation system has gone silent. Engineers suspect a rogue cult and their disturbing rituals.

node_01.name: Ventilation Access Shaft
node_01.base_description: A cold, metallic shaft descends into darkness. The air is thick with the smell of ozone and decay. Faint grinding sounds echo from below.
node_01.lore_fragment: The Sky-Cities are not built, but grown. Ancient, colossal machines form their foundations, their gears turning with a life of their own. The Static Mist is their lifeblood, and their slow decay is our doom.

node_02.name: The Grinding Chamber
node_02.base_description: Massive, rusted gears dominate this chamber, still turning with a deafening groan. The floor is slick with an oily residue. Strange symbols are etched into the metal.
node_02.lore_fragment: The Whispering Cog believes the machinery is divine. They perform rituals to appease the 'Great Grinder,' hoping to hasten its awakening and usher in a new age of mechanical enlightenment.
node_02.enemy_attack_flavor: Whirls a rusty wrench with cultic fervor.

node_03.name: The Static Conduit
node_03.base_description: A narrow passage where the air crackles with raw energy. Wires hang precariously, sparking intermittently. A large, locked grate blocks further progress.
node_03.lore_fragment: Technomancy is a dangerous art. The Static Mist can grant immense power, but prolonged exposure warps the mind and body, leading to 'Static Sickness' or the dreaded 'Haywiring' of one's very being.
node_03.puzzle_obstacle: A heavy grate secured by a complex, sparking lock. The lock is humming with residual static energy.

node_04.name: The Scavenger's Nest
node_04.base_description: A small alcove filled with discarded parts and crude tools. The stench of unwashed bodies hangs heavy in the air. A hulking figure guards the entrance to the next area.
node_04.lore_fragment: Goblins, once common pests, have adapted to the lower city's decay. They scavenge for anything useful, often falling prey to the cultists or becoming their unwilling servants.
node_04.enemy_attack_flavor: Swings a massive, crudely fashioned hammer.

node_05.name: The Heart of the Machine
node_05.base_description: This vast chamber houses a colossal, pulsating mechanism. The air is thick with the hum of latent power and the chanting of cultists. At the center, a robed figure directs the ritual.
node_05.lore_fragment: The cult believes that by feeding the ancient machinery with energy and sacrifice, they can awaken its true purpose, a purpose that may involve the destruction of the Sky-Cities and the liberation of the surface.
node_05.enemy_attack_flavor: Channels raw static energy through a corrupted cog.
